incident_description: Four of five commercial projects exceeded budget by 15-25%.

why_chain.question: Why over budget?
why_chain.answer: Material costs were higher than estimates.

why_chain.question: Why higher?
why_chain.answer: Price database was outdated.

why_chain.question: Why outdated?
why_chain.answer: Team should update prices monthly but does not.

why_chain.question: Why not update?
why_chain.answer: They need to integrate supplier APIs.

why_chain.question: Why no integration?
why_chain.answer: Management should approve a software purchase.

root_cause: Management should approve estimating software integration.
negative_reason: INVALID: Answers use solution/future tense ('should integrate API', 'need to buy software'); 5-Why requires past-state organizational facts, not recommendations.

incident_description: Four of five recent commercial projects exceeded budget by 15-25%, reducing average project margin from 18% to 4%.

why_chain.question: Why are projects over budget?
why_chain.answer: Material costs consistently exceed estimates by 12-20% across all four over-budget projects.

why_chain.question: Why are material estimates too low?
why_chain.answer: Estimators use a price database updated only once per year while material prices fluctuate quarterly.

why_chain.question: Why is the database updated only annually?
why_chain.answer: The update process is manual, takes three full days, and is deprioritized during busy estimating seasons.

why_chain.question: Why is the update manual?
why_chain.answer: Estimating software purchased in 2018 predates suppliers' modern API pricing systems; no integration was built.

why_chain.question: Why was no integration built?
why_chain.answer: IT budget is allocated exclusively to field operations tools; back-office estimating software has no dedicated technology improvement budget or owner.

root_cause: No dedicated back-office technology budget or owner for estimating systems, preventing integration with supplier pricing APIs.
corrective_actions: Create back-office technology budget with owner accountability.
Integrate estimating software with top-3 supplier pricing APIs.

incident_description: Seven wrong-dosage medication errors were reported in the oncology ward over one quarter, up from one in the previous quarter.

why_chain.question: Why are wrong dosages being administered?
why_chain.answer: Nurses manually calculate doses from weight-based tables instead of using the electronic prescribing system.

why_chain.question: Why are doses calculated manually?
why_chain.answer: The electronic system frequently times out during peak hours (8-10 AM), forcing staff to use paper charts.

why_chain.question: Why does the system time out during peak hours?
why_chain.answer: Hospital network bandwidth was not upgraded when the oncology ward added 30 new connected devices last quarter.

why_chain.question: Why was the network not upgraded?
why_chain.answer: IT resource planning is annual during budget season, but ward equipment purchases are approved independently throughout the year.

why_chain.question: Why are equipment purchases not coordinated with IT?
why_chain.answer: There is no cross-departmental procurement policy requiring an IT infrastructure impact assessment before adding networked devices to any ward.

root_cause: Missing cross-departmental procurement policy requiring IT infrastructure impact assessment before purchasing networked clinical devices.
corrective_actions: Implement procurement policy with mandatory IT impact assessment.
Upgrade oncology ward bandwidth with 50% headroom.

incident_description: A production line in an automotive parts factory experienced recurring unplanned CNC milling machine stops, costing an estimated $15,000 per incident in lost output.

why_chain.question: Why does the CNC milling machine stop unexpectedly?
why_chain.answer: The thermal overload protection trips due to excessive motor temperature during continuous operation.

why_chain.question: Why does the motor overheat?
why_chain.answer: Coolant flow is insufficient to dissipate heat during continuous milling cycles.

why_chain.question: Why is coolant flow insufficient?
why_chain.answer: The coolant filter is partially clogged with metal shavings, restricting flow by approximately 40%.

why_chain.question: Why is the filter clogged?
why_chain.answer: The filter has not been replaced in 6 months, well past its 2-month service interval.

why_chain.question: Why was the filter not replaced on schedule?
why_chain.answer: There is no preventive maintenance schedule for coolant system components; replacements only happen after breakdowns.

root_cause: Absence of a preventive maintenance schedule for coolant system components, causing deferred filter replacement until failure.
contributing_factors: No visual coolant flow indicator on the machine panel.
Maintenance backlog prioritized production uptime over PM tasks.
corrective_actions: Implement PM checklist with coolant filter replacement every 8 weeks.
Add real-time coolant flow gauge with low-flow alarm.
severity: Production loss / near-miss to equipment damage

incident_description: Checkout abandonment rose from 35% to 58% after shipping price increase.

why_chain.question: Why abandonment?
why_chain.answer: Shipping cost is too high at checkout.

why_chain.question: Why too high?
why_chain.answer: Carrier increased prices.

why_chain.question: Why carrier increase?
why_chain.answer: Because carrier contract changed.

why_chain.question: Why contract change?
why_chain.answer: Because new carrier charges more.

why_chain.question: Why more charges?
why_chain.answer: Because vendor pricing went up.
